CREATIVE ARTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow

   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
